- [RARC.9.3.4] **Service declarations reached by `import`.** An adapter
  declares the services it hosts in its `.ds` library file, and a rule
  file reaches them by importing that library ([LADP.8.1]).
  Those declarations are a compile-time input: the compiler resolves each
  `call <service>` against the declared set and builds the dispatch table
  at compile time ([LADP.8.2]). A `call` naming a service that is not in
  scope is a compile failure — `DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_SERVICE`
  ([LADP.8.2.3], [LCRS.10.4.2]).
